items.fact: WordPiece criterion: maximise P(ab)/(P(a)P(b)), i.e. PMI, not raw frequency
items.phrase: pointwise mutual information up to a constant
items.note: nuance added: this is the HF course's reconstruction; the original criterion is LM likelihood gain, and the HF library's WordPieceTrainer runs plain BPE

items.fact: WordPiece encoding: greedy longest-match-first with ## continuation prefixes
Unigram LM (Kudo): start large, fit unigram LM with EM, prune tokens whose removal least hurts likelihood
